name: Vivian Plasencia
description: Vivian Plasencia is a Software Engineer in the Technical Foundations team at the Ethereum Foundation. She works with governments and multilateral organizations to explore Ethereum through technical advisory and proofs of concept for real-world use cases. She has worked on several zero-knowledge protocols, libraries, and privacy-preserving applications. Her work combines research and open-source development to build practical privacy-preserving solutions for the Ethereum ecosystem.
